info.title: Monevo API
info.description:
REST API of a self-hosted Monevo instance. Errors use application/problem+json with a stable `code`.

## Authenticating integrations

Create a personal API token in Settings → API tokens and send it as `Authorization: Bearer mnv_pat_…`. Only operations that list `x-monevo-permissions` accept tokens, and the token must hold every listed permission. Browser clients use the session cookie and send `X-CSRF-Token` on unsafe methods.

cookieAuth.name: __Host-monevo_session
cookieAuth.description: Browser session (unsafe methods also need the `X-CSRF-Token` header).

apiToken.description: Personal API token; the operation lists the needed permissions in `x-monevo-permissions`.

Readiness: database reachable, migrations applied, not shutting down
Start sign-in (or re-authentication) at the identity provider

302.description: Redirect to the identity provider, or to `/login?error=idp_unavailable`

get.description: Browser navigation. Redirects to the requested page, or to `/login?error=<code>` with one of `idp_unavailable`, `login_failed`, `access_denied`, `account_deactivated`, `reauth_mismatch`.

get.summary: The current session, user and CSRF token

Revoke every session except the current one

get.description: API tokens receive no email address.
The `ETag` header carries the version for `If-Match`.

patch.description: Needs `If-Match: "<version>"` or `version`. The base currency cannot change after onboarding (`errors[].code` `BASE_CURRENCY_LOCKED`).

post.description: Session only; never available to API tokens. Needs `confirm: true` and `If-Match: "<version>"` or `version`. Allowed before and after onboarding. Original amounts are never changed.

get.summary: Personal API tokens (active, and revoked or expired within 90 days)

post.summary: Create a token; the secret is returned only in this response
post.description: Requires a re-authentication at the identity provider within 15 minutes.

patch.description: Requires a recent re-authentication. Refused while roles follow the identity provider group (`OIDC_ADMIN_GROUP`).

post.summary: Deactivate a user and revoke their sessions and API tokens
post.description: Requires a recent re-authentication. Administrators cannot deactivate themselves.

get.description: Settings set by an environment variable are reported with `lockedByEnv: true`.

patch.description: Changing a setting enforced by an environment variable returns `SETTING_LOCKED_BY_ENV`.

get.summary: Stored rates: the caller’s manual rates and cached provider rates

post.summary: Create or replace a manual rate for a pair and date
post.description: Manual rates take precedence over provider rates for the same date. `201` when created, `200` when an existing manual rate was replaced.

post.summary: Resolve the rate for a pair and date
post.description: Runs the resolution algorithm (manual, cached provider rate, on-demand provider fetch, stale rate up to 7 days). A missing rate or provider outage returns `status: MISSING`, never an error. Future dates use the latest rate and set `estimate`.

The client may supply the `id` (offline-first); an id already in use returns `ID_CONFLICT`. The opening balance must fit the currency exponent (`errors[].code` `AMOUNT_PRECISION`); inactive currencies are refused (`CURRENCY_INACTIVE`).

get.description: The `ETag` header carries the version for `If-Match`.

patch.description: `If-Match: "<version>"` (or `version`) is optional for browser sessions and required for API tokens (`428`). The currency stays editable while the account has no postings.

delete.description: `If-Match: "<version>"` (or `version`) is optional for browser sessions and required for API tokens (`428`).

get.description: A flat list; subcategories reference their parent. An archived parent hides its subcategories.

post.description: The parent must be a top-level, non-archived category of the same type. The client may supply the `id`; an id already in use returns `ID_CONFLICT`.
Sets `sortOrder` to the position in `ids`. All ids must be siblings (same parent and type). Returns every category.

get.description: The `ETag` header carries the version for `If-Match`.

patch.summary: Change, move or promote a category
patch.description: `If-Match: "<version>"` (or `version`) is optional for browser sessions and required for API tokens (`428`). `parentId: null` promotes a subcategory. The type of a category with subcategories cannot change.

delete.summary: Delete a category and its subcategories
delete.description: `If-Match: "<version>"` (or `version`) is optional for browser sessions and required for API tokens (`428`).

post.description: Idempotent. Subcategories keep their own state but are hidden while the parent is archived.
Idempotent. A subcategory under an archived parent stays hidden until the parent is restored.
